usage.rust_orange_rules: Use #C6561A strictly for highlights, badges, active states, key CTAs, and thin structural dividing lines
usage.forest_green_sparing: Use #4C5C52 sparingly for specialized metrics, verified indicators, and subtle tag fills
usage.forbidden: NO neon colors, NO gradients, NO glassmorphism, NO heavy shadows, NO 3D styling

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-serif font-light tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
hierarchy.section_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.body_text: text-base sm:text-lg font-sans font-normal leading-relaxed text-[#606060]
hierarchy.nav_links: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase font-mono tracking-[0.15em] font-medium

layout_and_spacing.dividing_lines: Restrained 1px solid thin rules (border-[#C6561A]/30 or border-current/20)
layout_and_spacing.header_strategy: Sticky opaque/semi-solid header with backdrop blur bg-[#1C1C1C]/95 text-[#EFE9DB] z-50 border-b border-[#EFE9DB]/10
layout_and_spacing.hero_overlay: Max overlay opacity bg-[#1C1C1C]/40 to let cinematic high-contrast photograph pop while maintaining high readability

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling enabled globally
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Framer Motion line-by-line text reveals and clip-path slide reveals
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial drift marquee using react-fast-marquee with low-contrast editorial serif typography
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp text-color shifts to #C6561A, subtle 1px border highlights, 0.2s duration. NO scale scaling chaos.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; high-contrast focus rings ring-2 ring-[#C6561A] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#1C1C1C]

bilingual_support.rule: State stored in React context or URL query parameter; preserves current route and active view

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: Every interactive and key informational element MUST have a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts Cormorant Garamond and Inter in public/index.html or index.css.
Implement Lenis smooth momentum scrolling in App.js or main entry file.
Build a robust LanguageContext supporting EN/ES translations across all 8 views.
Ensure header nav has opaque/backdrop-blur styling with high-contrast text and language switcher.
Maintain high contrast editorial aesthetics with alternating Carbon Black (#1C1C1C) and Bone (#EFE9DB) sections.
Use thin border rules in Rust Orange (#C6561A) or subdued current color to separate content.
Ensure demo forms display a clear 'Demo Submission Simulated' notification using Sonner toasts.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, links, and cards carry kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop: no center-everything, no heavy blue gradients, no glass card overload.
Dark colors look good when used solid with high-contrast serif headlines.
Do NOT use cartoon animals for Flight Levels. Use Tier codes LVL-01 to LVL-05.
Always specify explicit hover text colors (e.g. hover:text-[#C6561A]).
Use generous padding (py-24 to py-36 for major sections) to create an editorial magazine feel.
